prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Wide landscape hand-painted anime watercolor fantasy JRPG BACKGROUND ONLY, no people no words no interface, warm ivory limestone and muted sage/gold. Lower third will be covered by translucent dialogue window and must continue scenery. Gentle daylight, high quality painterly details, no portal drawn no hands no living figures.
